paper_title: Constraining Ultralight Dark Matter through an Accelerated Resonant Search
notes: Paper presents new measured exclusion limits on axion-neutron coupling g_ann in the 4.5–15.5 Hz Compton-frequency range (corresponding to axion masses ~1.9e-14 to 6.4e-14 eV using m_a = 4.136e-15 * f_a). The experiment uses a 21Ne-Rb-K hybrid spin magnetometer operating in NMR mode with Fermi-contact enhancement. Data points extracted from Fig. 3 (red spiky line showing 95% CL sensitivity). The paper also constrains axion-proton coupling g_app but the pre-analysis hint and primary focus is on neutron coupling. Local DM density ρ_DM = 0.4 GeV/cm³ is explicitly stated in Methods (Eq. 17). The experiment achieves ~30-fold acceleration in scan step while maintaining competitive sensitivity, surpassing previous ChangE-HSR limits by several-fold and exceeding astrophysical neutron-star cooling bounds in the 4.6–6.6 Hz and ~7.5 Hz bands. No ALP signal detected; limits are exclusion bounds at 95% confidence level. | selector: text (sole candidate)
